title: ImGui orthographic projection assumes a lower-left clip origin on an upper-left (y-down) clip space
expected_finding: ProjMtx maps display y = DisplayPos.y (top, y-down display coordinates) to clip y = +1, the convention for a lower-left clip origin; the target's clip space has an upper-left origin (y down), so the whole UI is flipped vertically (T and B must be swapped)
